title: Webhook Events and Settings
instructions: Implement the webhook parsing layer and settings in `events.py`. Give the three event models their fields and a discriminated union (`Event`), build the `TypeAdapter`s once at module level, and implement strict `parse_events` and lenient `parse_events_lenient` (good events plus `ItemError`s). Finish `WebhookSettings` with the `WEBHOOK_` prefix, `.env` support, a `SecretStr` secret of at least 8 characters, and a bounded `tolerance_s`.

evidence.label: Parses a mixed batch into the right event classes, in order
Strict parsing fails with an error location starting at the bad item index
Lenient parsing returns valid events plus ItemErrors (union_tag_invalid, greater_than)
Reports union_tag_not_found, raises ValueError for non-arrays, and reports non-object items
Enforces id, currency, timestamp and required-field constraints on events
Reads WEBHOOK_ environment variables and hides the secret from repr
A missing or too-short secret raises ValidationError
tolerance_s defaults to 300 and must be an int in 1 to 3600
Reads a .env file and ignores unknown keys
